$comment: Stories whose parity case is container-scoped but which draw no `SourceFrame`: the capture forces the source width, so the numbers match Figma while a reader sees another composition (the global `centered` layout shrinks the story root until every `@container` variant flips). The list only shrinks. `figma:parity:capture` measures the story's own frame before forcing anything and fails `story-collapsed` for a story below; `figma:parity:verify` fails when an entry no longer owes a frame, and warns for each entry still owed. The fix is always the story: wrap the composition in `SourceFrame` from `apps/storybook/src/support/source-frame.tsx` and delete its entry.
